description: Read one comment in full: what the reviewer said, the element it is pinned to, its status, priority, labels, assignee and replies, plus the screenshot of what the reviewer saw, returned as an image. Use it when the user asks about a specific comment, or to look at the screenshot before making a change.

include_screenshot.description: Return the reviewer's screenshot as an image. Default true.

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page, like https://htmlannotate.com/manage/<page>#k=<key>

name: get_comment
title: Read one comment
